questions.questionText:
Which of the following is irrational?
A) 0.25  B) √2  C) 3/4  D) 0.5

The value of log₁₀(1000) is:
A) 1  B) 2  C) 3  D) 10

The power set of {a,b} contains how many subsets?
A) 2  B) 3  C) 4  D) 5

A factor of x²−9 is:
A) x−9  B) x+9  C) x−3  D) x²+3

The common factor of 6x and 9x² is:
A) 3x  B) 6x²  C) 9x  D) 3x²

The solution of 2x+5=13 is:
A) 3  B) 4  C) 5  D) 9

sin 30° equals:
A) 0  B) 1/2  C) √3/2  D) 1

The value of sin²θ+cos²θ is:
A) 0  B) 1  C) tanθ  D) 2

The slope of the line y=5x+3 is:
A) 3  B) −3  C) 5  D) −5

If the corresponding sides of two triangles are proportional and their corresponding angles are equal, the triangles are:
A) congruent only  B) similar  C) always right-angled  D) unequal

The graph of y=2x+1 is a:
A) circle  B) straight line  C) parabola  D) pair of parallel lines

The locus of points equidistant from the endpoints of a segment is its:
A) angle bisector  B) perpendicular bisector  C) median  D) altitude

The arithmetic mean of 2, 4 and 6 is:
A) 3  B) 4  C) 5  D) 6

The probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed is:
A) 0  B) 1/4  C) 1/2  D) 1
Express 0.375 as a fraction in lowest terms.
Classify √49 and √7 as rational or irrational.
Evaluate log₂(32).
Find the characteristic of log₁₀(0.00056).
Find A∪B if A={a,b,c} and B={b,d}.
Write the power set of {p,q}.
Factorize x²+5x+6.
Factorize 4a²−25.
Solve 3(x−2)=12.
Convert 150° into radians.
Find the arc length when r=6 cm and θ=π/3 radians.
Evaluate 2cos(π/6)sin(π/6).
Find the distance between (0,3) and (−2,−4).
Find the slope joining (3,−2) and (2,7).
Write the equation of the horizontal line through (7,−9).
Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in ratio 2:3. Find the ratio of their areas.
questions.answerText: Area ratio is the square of side ratio: 2²:3²=4:9.

questions.questionText: If two corresponding angles of two triangles are equal, and their third angles are also equal, what can be concluded?
questions.answerText: The triangles are equiangular and therefore similar.

questions.questionText: The sides of two similar triangles are in ratio 3:5. If a side of the smaller is 9 cm, find the corresponding larger side.
Find y when x=3 in y=2x−1.
Give two points that lie on y=x+2.
Define the perpendicular bisector of a line segment.
questions.answerText: A line through the segment's midpoint and perpendicular to it.

questions.questionText: What is the locus of points at a fixed distance from a fixed point?
questions.answerText: A circle centred at the fixed point with the given radius.

questions.questionText: Find the arithmetic mean of 4, 6, 8 and 10.
Find the mode of 3, 5, 5, 6, 7, 5, 8.
questions.answerText: The mode is 5, as it occurs most often.

questions.questionText: Find the median of 2, 4, 7, 9, 12.
A fair die is rolled. Find the probability of getting an even number.
Define sample space for a single coin toss.
questions.answerText: S={H,T}, the set of all possible outcomes.

questions.questionText: Q5 — (a) Simplify √50+√8. (b) Solve log₁₀x=−2.
Q6 — (a) For A={1,2,3,4} and B={3,4,5}, find A∪B and A∩B. (b) Factorize x⁴−5x²+4.
Q7 — (a) Solve 2x−3≤7 and represent the solution interval. (b) Prove (tanθ+cotθ)²=sec²θ cosec²θ.
questions.answerText: (a) 2x≤10, x≤5; interval (−∞,5]. (b) tanθ+cotθ=(sin²θ+cos²θ)/(sinθcosθ)=1/(sinθcosθ); squaring gives sec²θ cosec²θ.

questions.questionText: Q8 — (a) Find the distance between A(0,2) and B(3,6), and state the slope of AB. (b) Two similar triangles have corresponding sides 6 cm and 9 cm. If the area of the smaller is 24 cm², find the area of the larger.
questions.answerText: (a) Distance=√[(3−0)²+(6−2)²]=5; slope=(6−2)/(3−0)=4/3. (b) Side ratio=2:3, area ratio=4:9; larger area=24×9/4=54 cm².

questions.questionText: Q9 — (a) For 4, 6, 6, 8, 10, find mean, median and mode. (b) A bag has 3 red and 2 blue balls. Find the probability of selecting a blue ball.

questions.topic: Tangent and Angles of a Circle
questions.questionText: How many tangents can be drawn to a circle from a point outside it?
Name the locus of the centre of a circle passing through two fixed points.
questions.answerText: The perpendicular bisector of the segment joining the two fixed points

questions.questionText: Find the median of 3, 7, 9, 11 and 15.
A fair die is rolled. Find the probability of getting an even number.
Express (2 + 5i) − (4 − i) in a + bi form.
Find the discriminant of 3x² + 2x − 1 = 0.
Find the determinant of [[1, 2], [3, 4]].
Simplify (4 + 3i)(2 − i) and express the result in a + bi form.
Solve 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0 by factorisation.
For A = [[2, 1], [3, 4]], find det(A) and state whether A is singular.
questions.answerText: det(A) = (2)(4) − (1)(3) = 8 − 3 = 5. Since determinant is non-zero, A is non-singular.

questions.questionText: For f(x) = x² − 2x − 3, find f(0), f(1) and the zeros of f.
questions.answerText: f(0) = −3; f(1) = −4. Factorising x² − 2x − 3 = (x − 3)(x + 1), the zeros are x = 3 and x = −1.

questions.questionText: Simplify (x² − 4)/(x² + 4x + 4) and state the restriction on x.
questions.answerText: Factor: (x − 2)(x + 2)/(x + 2)². For x ≠ −2, the simplified form is (x − 2)/(x + 2).

questions.questionText: In a right-angled triangle, an acute angle θ has opposite side 5 cm and hypotenuse 13 cm. Find sin θ and cos θ.
questions.answerText: Adjacent side = √(13² − 5²) = √144 = 12 cm. Thus sin θ = 5/13 and cos θ = 12/13.

questions.questionText: Find the magnitude and direction angle of vector v = 3i + 4j, measured from the positive x-axis.

questions.topic: Chords and Arcs of a Circle
questions.questionText: A chord AB subtends an angle of 70° at a point C on the major arc AB. If D is another point on the major arc AB, find ∠ADB and state the theorem used.
questions.answerText: Angles in the same segment are equal. Therefore ∠ADB = ∠ACB = 70°.

questions.questionText: Construct the perpendicular bisector of a line segment AB of length 6 cm using compass and ruler. Describe the construction.
questions.answerText: Draw AB = 6 cm. With compass radius greater than 3 cm, draw arcs from A above and below AB. With the same radius, draw arcs from B intersecting the first pair at P and Q. Join P and Q. PQ is the perpendicular bisector of AB and meets it at its midpoint.

questions.topic: Tangent and Angles of a Circle
questions.questionText: From an external point P, tangents PA and PB touch a circle at A and B. If PA = 7 cm, find PB and name the theorem used.
questions.answerText: Tangents drawn from the same external point to a circle are equal. Hence PB = PA = 7 cm.
